_comment: Reference UI legend per ADR 0054 Phase 1. Colors picked for maximum perceptual separation in CIE Lab space — primary hues at high saturation, no near-neighbors. Per-game legends can override colors, drop entries, or add new ones. Each entry's `name` matches the HUD panel role; the extractor classifies rects into 9 screen anchors (top-left, top-center, top-right, center-left, center, center-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right).
name: ui_default

entries._comment: Background — large solid neutral. Anti-cluster pad: the wireframe should have a clean background so this dominates pixel count and isn't confused with a component.
entries.name: background
